intro: Today's news highlights key developments in Armenia's international engagements, particularly around COP17 in Yerevan, alongside ongoing diplomatic efforts with Turkey and Iran, and notable cultural and economic updates.

topics.title: COP17 Leaders' Summit held in Yerevan with biodiversity focus
topics.text: The Yerevan Declaration was adopted at the COP17 Leaders' Summit, providing political support for biodiversity talks. Armenian officials, including the President and Foreign Minister, engaged with UN Secretary-General António Guterres and other leaders on environmental cooperation and funding, including a $500 million biodiversity funding announcement.

topics.text: Armenian and Turkish officials discussed opportunities for direct trade in multiple meetings, involving the economy minister, agriculture minister, and central bank updates. These talks are part of broader normalization efforts at the bilateral level.

topics.title: Armenia engages with Iran and UNESCO on cooperation
topics.text: The Armenian Prime Minister met with Iran's President Pezeshkian at the Yerevan Summit to discuss Armenia-Iran cooperation. Separately, the Foreign Minister and UNESCO Director-General discussed collaboration, as did the President of Armenia with UNESCO's chief.
